page_overview_description: Dashboard overview of AI visibility and citations.
page_visibility_description: Track how LLMs respond to prompts about your brand.
page_share_description: How often AI engines mention you versus your competitors.
page_share_info: Share of voice is how often each brand is mentioned in the AI answers to your prompts. Mentions are counted per run, so the brand and competitor figures use the same unit and are directly comparable.
page_share_info_filters: Competitors are the ones you track in settings. Switch the model filter to compare engines.
page_share_empty: No mention data yet for the selected filters. Mentions appear once your prompts have been run.
share_mentions_tip: Number of runs in which this brand was mentioned in the AI answer.

page_fanout_description: The web searches AI engines run when answering your prompts.
page_fanout_meta_description: See the web searches AI engines run when answering your prompts, and how they rewrite your wording.
page_fanout_info: When an AI engine with web search capabilities responds to a prompt, it may choose to make a number of web searches before creating its answer. These underlying web searches, or web queries, are only available for some engines.
fanout_load_error: Couldn't load query fan-out right now. Reload the page to try again.
fanout_no_runs: No runs with web search enabled for the selected filters. Fan-out appears once your prompts have been run by an engine with web search.
fanout_no_queries_exposed: No web queries in this period — the engines you track didn't expose any searches for these prompts and filters.
fanout_prompt_searches: The web searches each prompt triggers.
fanout_recurring_searches: The searches that recur across your prompts.
fanout_runs_tip: Runs of this prompt that issued the search
page_citations_description: See which sources LLMs cite when responding to your prompts.
page_citations_meta_description: See which sources LLMs cite in responses to your prompts.
page_citations_info: Citations are the links and sources that AI models include in their responses when answering your prompts. They show which websites the AI considers authoritative or relevant to your topics.
page_citations_competitor_prefix: Competitor domains are only those you've added to your
page_citations_competitor_suffix: Other domains appear under their detected category (Google, Social Media, Institutional, or Other).
page_opportunities_description: What to create, pitch, and seed to earn more AI citations — generated from your tracked answer data.
page_opportunities_meta_description: AI-generated opportunities to earn more AI citations.
page_opportunities_info: Recommendations based on your visibility and citation metrics. Refreshed weekly.
opportunities_error: Couldn't generate recommendations right now. Reload the page to try again.
opportunities_insufficient: We need a bit more tracking data before we can recommend opportunities — check back once your prompts have run for a few days.
opportunities_analyzing: Analyzing your citation landscape and drafting your opportunities…
dashboard_research_description: We will analyze your website and find the best generative AI prompts to track. This process may take a couple of minutes.
dashboard_waiting_message: You are ready to track your AI visibility. We're currently running the first evaluation against AI models. This usually takes a few minutes.
dashboard_disabled_prompts_message: You have prompts configured but none are currently enabled. Add or enable some prompts to start tracking your AI visibility.
dashboard_no_prompts_message: Set up prompts to start tracking your AI visibility. Once configured, we'll evaluate them against AI models automatically.
dashboard_refresh_hint: Refresh this page in a few minutes to see your AI visibility data.
dashboard_visibility_tip: The percentage of AI answers to your prompts that mention your brand. The large number is the latest point on the line. For prompts that don't name your brand, it is {nonBrandedVisibility}%. Visibility shifts as AI models, tracked prompts, or scanned sites change; the line is smoothed for staggered prompt schedules.
dashboard_share_tip: Your brand's share of all brand and competitor mentions across AI answers to your prompts. The large number is the latest point on the line. It shifts as AI models, published content, or scanned sites change; the line is smoothed for staggered prompt schedules.
dashboard_prompts_tracked_tip: Total number of unique prompts monitored for AI visibility across the configured AI models.
dashboard_evaluations_tip: Total prompt evaluations against AI models during the last 30 days. Each prompt is evaluated multiple times across models.
dashboard_run_frequency_tip: Prompts are automatically evaluated about every {frequency} on average to track response changes over time.
dashboard_last_updated_tip: The last prompts evaluated for your brand ran on {date}.
dashboard_no_evaluations_tip: No evaluations have been run yet.

chart_longer_period: Try selecting a longer time period to see historical data.

settings_brand_description: Manage your brand name and website.

settings_brand_aliases_tip: Alternative names for your brand, such as sub-brands, product lines, or abbreviations. They are used for mention detection in future prompt runs and do not apply retroactively to past results.
settings_competitors_description: Manage your competitive landscape for reputation tracking.
settings_competitors_warning: Updating competitors applies only to future prompt evaluations. Citation categorization updates retroactively.
settings_llms_meta_description: View tracked AI models and configuration.
settings_llms_description: Your prompts are evaluated against these AI models to track how your brand appears across different types of AI search.
settings_llms_none: No models are configured for this brand. Set SCRAPE_TARGETS at the deployment level, or adjust this brand's enabledModels.
settings_llms_model_tip: Which AI model this card covers.
settings_llms_provider_tip: How this deployment reaches the model — direct API, a scraping proxy, etc.
settings_llms_version_tip: Exact upstream model version requested from the provider.
settings_llms_web_search_tip: Is web search used to answer prompts?
settings_team_meta_description: Invite teammates and manage team members.

competitor_name_tip: The primary name used to detect this competitor in AI responses. Mention detection applies to future prompt runs only.

competitor_aliases_tip: Alternative names for this competitor, such as sub-brands, product names, or abbreviations. They are used for mention detection in future prompt runs only and do not apply retroactively.
competitor_maximum: Maximum of {max} competitors allowed. Remove a competitor to add a new one.

citations_page_types_tip: Share of citations by page type over time — the kind of page each citation points to, inferred from the URL and title.

citations_unique_domains_tip: The number of distinct domains cited across all prompt evaluations in this period.
citations_total_tip: The total external websites cited by AI models across prompt evaluations.
citations_content_gaps_tip: Prompts where competitors are cited but your brand isn't — opportunities to improve your citation presence.

citations_gap_summary_many: {competitors} competitors cited {citations} times — your brand cited 0 times
